metadata.change_reason: User journey and story suite standard, enforcing 100% touchpoint coverage, INVEST value flow principles, and zero system-exception pollution

spec.name: User Personas, Journeys & Story Suite Quality Standard

rules.statement: User story suite must achieve 100% coverage over all declared journey touchpoints
User stories must adhere to INVEST principles, specifying persona, goal, business value, and priority
The role in every user story must trace back to declared user personas
Every user story must explicitly map to at least one upstream requirement REQA-xxx ID
Strictly prohibit low-level system error codes or database implementation details in user stories, focusing on user business value flow

When requirements or architecture specify administrative, operational, or back-office subsystems (e.g. ERP, supplier databases, RAG knowledge bases, finance settlement), personas and journeys must model distinct operational and administrative roles rather than solely C-end consumers
All operational stakeholders identified during requirement elicitation must possess dedicated personas, touchpoints, and value-delivering user stories
Every declared persona must possess distinct lifecycle journey touchpoints explicitly bound via actor_persona_id, with at least 2 touchpoints per persona
Every declared persona must possess at least 2 distinct operational business scenarios explicitly bound via persona_id covering both happy path and exception/edge conditions
Every declared persona must be allocated at least 2 distinct INVEST user stories delivering measurable business value, strictly forbidding orphan or token personas
All Journey and Story IDs (PSA, STG, TP, SCN, USR, EPIC) must be strictly formatted, globally unique, sequential without duplicate consecutive stage IDs within persona journeys
